name: The Patio
why_it_matters: Rooftop resto-cafe at Hotel Ganga Lahari overlooking the start of Har Ki Pauri ghats. Pure-vegetarian, no alcohol — the dining option Haridwar visitors choose when they want a Ganga view without the chaos of ghat-side dhabas. Live bhajan and acoustic Bollywood guitar sessions in the evening.
insider_tip: Book the corner table at sunset for the unobstructed Ganga frame. Leisure Hotels operates this property; non-residents can dine with prior intimation at the front desk.
signature_address: The Ganga Lahari, Gau Ghat, near Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar 249401

name: Annapurna Restaurant
why_it_matters: The main indoor restaurant at Hotel Ganga Lahari (Leisure Hotels Group) — pure-vegetarian only by hotel policy, multi-cuisine Indian and Continental on a single menu. Buffet at peak season; à la carte the rest of the year. Where the residential pilgrim crowd eats when the ghats are too crowded.
insider_tip: Annapurna runs an evening buffet during Yatra season (Apr–Jul + Oct) — book ahead through the front desk. Off-season the à la carte is faster and the portions are bigger.
signature_address: The Ganga Lahari, Gau Ghat, near Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar 249401

name: The Haveli Hari Ganga Restaurant
area: Hotel Haveli Hari Ganga (Pilibhit House), Sharvan Nath Nagar
why_it_matters: The in-house dining at Pilibhit House — the 19th-century riverside haveli of the Pilibhit royals, now a heritage hotel run as Hari Ganga Niwas (IHCL SeleQtions, formerly Leisure Hotels). Pure-vegetarian, no alcohol; emphasis on Garhwali regional cooking alongside the standard Indian-Continental menu. Riverside lawn seating + rooftop cafe.
insider_tip: Non-residents need to call ahead — the haveli isn't a walk-in venue. Ask for the Garhwali specials (phaanu, kaafli, chainsoo) which aren't always on the laminated menu but the kitchen will plate up given notice.
signature_address: Pilibhit House, Ramghat, Sharvan Nath Nagar, Haridwar 249401

name: Sattvik Restaurant
why_it_matters: In-house restaurant at Hotel Devnadi on the Ganga at Kankhal. Strict sattvic cuisine — no onion, no garlic, no alcohol — alongside a Chinese and Continental section for less austere palates. The dining option of choice for Daksha Mahadev pilgrims who want a riverside table without going back to Har Ki Pauri.
insider_tip: The sattvic menu and the Chinese menu are separate cards — ask for both. Jain food is prepared on a separate counter; flag it at order time.

name: Big Ben Restaurant
why_it_matters: AC family restaurant attached to Hotel Ganga Azure on the Haridwar railway-station road — pure-vegetarian, Jain food on request, no alcohol or smoking on premises. The standard pick for arrival or departure meals when the ghat-side options feel too rushed.
insider_tip: It's a five-minute walk from the railway station, which makes it the practical lunch stop on Yatra-arrival or pre-train days. The thali is the value play — Chinese is competent but not the kitchen's strength.
signature_address: Hotel Ganga Azure, Haridwar Main Road, Devpura, opposite Railway Road, Haridwar 249401

name: Hoshiyarpuri (Khanna Nagar branch)
why_it_matters: The fully-air-conditioned dine-in branch of the 1937 Hoshiyarpuri counter at Har Ki Pauri — opened on Jwalapur Road in 2015 to give the same family recipes a sit-down setting. Same kachori-sabzi and puri-aloo-chana, now with proper tables and a Punjabi mains menu the Upper Road counter doesn't have space for.
insider_tip: If you've already done the Bara Bazaar puri-walas, come here for the dal makhani and bhature — those are kitchen-only dishes the counter branch cannot make. Self-park is at Jagat Petrol Pump opposite.
signature_address: Near Jagat Petrol Pump, Jwalapur Haridwar Road, Khanna Nagar, Haridwar 249407

name: Flavours
why_it_matters: 78-cover all-day-dining at MJ Sarovar Portico, the chain's Haridwar property in Ranipur. Pure-vegetarian only (mandated by the city's status), live counters and a buffet for families who want hotel-grade hygiene without going to the ghat hotels.
insider_tip: Sunday brunch is the value pick — full buffet plus live tandoor for under ₹1500 per head when you book ahead. Walk-ins land à la carte only.
signature_address: MJ Sarovar Portico, Bahadrabad, Ranipur, Haridwar 249403

name: Aachman
why_it_matters: Ground-floor restaurant of GMVN's Hotel Alaknanda on Delhi Road in Belwala — government-run, pure-vegetarian, no-frills. The most reliable mid-budget hotel meal in Haridwar for families on the Char Dham circuit who use Alaknanda as a base.
insider_tip: GMVN runs the property; meals are open to non-residents but the kitchen closes 10–11pm sharp. Order the thali — the à la carte is slow when buses arrive.
signature_address: Hotel Alaknanda, Delhi Road, Belwala, Haridwar 249401
